title: Cache-aware prompt assembly order
description:
As an operator, I want a stable prefix, then lazy blocks, then the tail, in deterministic order, so that provider prefix caching keeps working.

Feature: Prompt assembly order
  Scenario: Blocks do not disturb the cached prefix
    Given a system prompt and tools
    When blocks render with unchanged data
    Then the assembled prefix is byte-identical across calls
    And blocks sit after tools and before the conversation tail
right_now_summary: The prompt assembly order is being defined to preserve a stable cached prefix.
